required_checks: reads deployed runtime bytecode from configured 420 network RPC
binds every result to chain ID, address and runtime code hash
accepts Solidity Standard JSON Input and multi-file bundles
records exact compiler version and settings
checks runtime bytecode and creation bytecode when recoverable
handles linked libraries, metadata and immutable references explicitly
reports FULL_MATCH, PARTIAL_MATCH, MISMATCH or UNVERIFIABLE with reasons
detects proxy relationships and verifies proxy/implementation separately
does not inherit verification across implementation upgrades
survives restart without losing published verification evidence
allows independent reproduction from published evidence

security_checks: never accepts wallet private keys or signing secrets
verification cannot authorize wallet or Smart Account capabilities
verified badge never implies audit, safety, official status or immutability
source/result provenance preserved when consumed by Explorer or AppStore
reproducibility_checks: same source/compiler/settings reproduce same reported code hash
different chain ID or deployed code hash cannot reuse prior result
metadata mismatch cannot be silently promoted to FULL_MATCH
new proxy implementation requires independent verification
alternative verifier can reproduce a published FULL_MATCH
